Daily Quiz.question: ১) George Bernard Shaw is a-
Daily Quiz.exp:
George Bernard Shaw was an Irish born dramatist or playwright. He is a modern dramatist and called the father of Modern English Drama.
He is famous for his 'Drama of Ideas'. He was awarded the Nobel Prize in 1925.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ২) 'Arrow of God' was written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Chinua Achebe is a Nigerian writer. His famous works: Arrow of God, Things Fall Apart, No Longer at Ease, A Man of the People etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩) Who is one of the exponents of 'Imagism'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Ezra Pound is an American poet and critic. He is one of the exponents of 'Imagism'. His major writings are The Cantos, ABC of Reading, Usura, Make It New, Literary Essays etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature and Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৪) Who is the author of 'The Trial'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Franz Kafka, German-language writer of visionary fiction whose works—especially the novel Der Prozess (1925; The Trial) and the story Die Verwandlung (1915; The Metamorphosis)—express the anxieties and alienation felt by many in 20th-century Europe and North America. His notable works are The Trial, The Castle, Amerika, In the Penal Colony, The Metamorphosis, Meditation, The Judgment, Description of a Struggle, Letter to Father.
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৫) Who is the author of 'In Our Time'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Ernest Hemingway, in full Ernest Miller Hemingway, American novelist and short-story writer, awarded the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1954 and Pulitzer Prize in 1953.
His notable works: A Farewell to Arms, The Sun Also Rises, The Old Man and the Sea, For Whom the Bell Tolls, In Our Time, The Short Happy Life of Francis Macomber, A Clean Well-Lighted Place, Hills like White Elephants, The Snows of Kilimanjaro, To Have and Have Not.
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৬) Who is the author of 'The Heart of the Matter'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Graham Greene is a English novelist. His famous works are The Heart of the Matter, The End of the Affair, It's a Battlefield, The Power and the Glory, The Human Factor, Doctor Fisher, The Tenth Man, The Last Word, Twenty-One Stories.
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica, An ABC of English Literature and Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৭) Who wrote the book 'The Time Machine'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
H. G. Wells is a British science fiction writer. His famous works are The Time Machine, The Invisible Man, The War of the Worlds, The Island of Dr. Moreau.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ৮) Who wrote the novel 'Brave New World'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Aldous Huxley, English novelist and critic gifted with an acute and far-ranging intelligence whose works are notable for their wit and pessimistic satire. He remains best known for one novel, Brave New World (1932), a model for much dystopian science fiction that followed.
His notable works: Brave New World, After Many a Summer Dies the Swan, Eyeless in Gaza, Point Counter Point, Crome Yellow, Antic Hay, Those Barren Leaves, The Doors of Perception, The Devils of Loudun.
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ৯) Who wrote the book 'Runaway'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Alice Munro, Canadian short-story writer who gained international recognition with her exquisitely drawn narratives. The Swedish Academy dubbed her a 'master of the contemporary short story' when it awarded her the Nobel Prize for Literature in 2013.
His notable works: Dance of the Happy Shades, Runaway, Dear Life, The Lives of Girls and Women, The View from Castle Rock, The Bear Came over the Mountain.
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১০) 'The Birthday Party' was written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Harold Pinter is British playwright. His famous works are The Birthday Party, The Care Taker, The Homecoming etc.
Source: An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ১১) Who is the writer of 'The Ambassadors'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Henry James is an American born English writer. His famous works are The Ambassadors, The Wings of Dove, The Golden Bowl, Portrait of a Lady, The American.
Source: An ABC of English Literature and Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১২) Who wrote the novel 'One Hundred Years of Solitude'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Gabriel Garcia Marquez, Colombian novelist and one of the greatest writers of the 20th century, who was awarded the Nobel Prize for Literature in 1982, mostly for his masterpiece 'One Hundred Years of Solitude'. His notable works are Love in the Time of Cholera, No One Writes to the Colonel, The Leaf Storm, Memories of My Melancholy Whores, News of a Kidnapping.
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৩) Who is creator of the popular and critically acclaimed Harry Potter series?
Daily Quiz.exp: J.K. Rowling, British author, creator of the popular and critically acclaimed Harry Potter series, about a young sorcerer in training. His notable works are Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone, Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban, The Cuckoo’s Calling, Lethal White, The Tales of Beedle the Bard, Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince, Harry Potter and the Cursed Child, Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows, Quidditch Through the Ages, Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৪) Who is the author of 'Shooting an Elephant'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
George Orwell is an English novelist, essayist, journalist and critic. His real name is Eric Hugh Blair. He was a police officer in Burma.
Shooting an Elephant is an Essay or Story by George Orwell.
His famous Novels: Animal Farm, Nineteen Eighty-Four, Burmese Days, Coming up for Air.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৫) Ernest Hemingway awarded Nobel Prize in-
Daily Quiz.exp:
Ernest Hemingway is an American novelist. He was awarded the Nobel prize in 1954 for literature and Pulitzer Prize in 1953.
His famous novels: A Farewell to Arms, The Old Man and The Sea, For Whom The Bell Tolls, The Sun Also Rises, Death in the Afternoon, To Have and Have not.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৬) Who is famous for his 'Drama of Ideas'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
George Bernard Shaw was an Irish born dramatist or playwright.
He is a modern dramatist and called the father of Modern English Drama. He is famous for his 'Drama of Ideas'. He was awarded the Nobel Prize in 1925.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৭) Who is the author of 'The Tell Tale Heart'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Edgar Allan Poe is an American Short Story writer and literary critic. He is The Father of English Short Story and Modern Detective Story.
His famous short story: The Tell Tale Heart, The Raven, The fall of the house of usher, The Black Cat, The Oval Portrait, The Gold Bug, The Light House.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৮) Who is the author of 'Wings of Fire'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, in full Avul Pakir Jainulabdeen Abdul Kalam, Indian scientist and politician who played a leading role in the development of India’s missile and nuclear weapons programs. He was president of India from 2002 to 2007. He was the 11th president of India.
His famous books: Wings of Fire, Ignited Mind, Inspiring Thought, The Luminous Sparks, Turning Points, You are Born to Bloom, Target 3 Billion, Indomitable Spirit, My Journey.
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ১৯) D. H. Lawrence is not the novelist of one following novels. Which is it?
Daily Quiz.exp:
D.H. Lawrence is a English novelist, poet and literary critic. His famous novels: Sons and Lovers, The Rainbow, Women in Love, The White Peacock, Lady Chatterley's Lover, Kangaroo etc. James Joyce wrote the novel Ulysses.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ২০) Who wrote the book 'Road to Freedom'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Bertrand Russell was British philosopher, logician, mathematician, history writer, social critic and political activist. He was awarded the Nobel prize in literature in 1950.
His famous writings: The Elements of Ethics, Human Knowledge, Road to Freedom, Authority and Individual, Marriage and Morals, Religion and Science, The Conquest of Happiness etc.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ২১) Who is the author of the play 'Exiles'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
​• Exiles:
- Irish author James Joyce রচিত একটি নাটক, যা প্রথম ১৯১৮ সালে প্রকাশিত হয়।
- নাটকটি পরশ্রীকাতরতা, বিশ্বস্ততা, স্বরূপ এবং ব্যক্তিগত স্বাধীনতা ও সামাজিক প্রত্যাশার মধ্যে সংগ্রামের মত বেশ জটিল বিষয় নিয়ে রচিত।
- এটি Richard Rowan নামক একজন আইরিশ পুরুষের গল্প, যে ইউরোপে নির্বাসিত হয়ে বসবাস করে, এবং তার স্ত্রী Bertha, এবং close friend, Robert -এর সাথে সম্পর্কের সমস্যাগুলোর উপর ভিত্তি করে লেখা।

Daily Quiz.question: ২২) Who is the author of 'A Passage to India'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Edward Morgan Forster is a famous English novelist.
His famous novels: A Passage to India, Where Angels Fear to Tread, The Longest Journey, A Room with a View, The Celestial Omnibus (Collection of Short Stories), Aspects of Novel, The Eternal Moment and Other Stories.
Source: Live MCQ lecture and An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৩) Who is the author of 'Three Musketeers'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Alexander Dumas is a French writer. His notable works: Three Musketeers, The Gold Thieves (drama), Twenty Years After etc.
Source: Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৪) Who wrote the play 'Pygmalion'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
George Bernard Shaw is the Greatest Modern Dramatist and He is called the father of modern English Drama. He is famous for his 'Drama of Ideas'. He was awarded the Nobel prize in 1925.
His famous plays: The Apple Cart, Arms and the Man, Man and Superman, Doctor's Dilemma, Pygmalion, Caesar and Cleopatra, St. Joan, The Philanderer, Major Barbara, Heartbreak House, The Devil's Discipline, You Never Can Tell.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৫) Who wrote the book 'The God of Small Things'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Arundhati Roy is an Indian author, actress, and political activist who was best known for the award winning novel for The God of Small Things (1997) and for her involvement in environmental and human rights causes.
His notable works: The Ministry of Utmost Happiness, The God of Small Things.
Source: Encyclopedia of Britannica.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৬) Ernest Hemingway is the author of-
Daily Quiz.option2: খ) The Sound and the Fury
Daily Quiz.option4: ঘ) The Old Man and the Sea
Daily Quiz.exp:
Ernest Hemingway is an American novelist. He was awarded the Nobel prize in 1954 for literature.
His famous novels: The Old Man and The Sea, For Whom The Bell Tolls, A Farewell to Arms, The Sun Also Rises, Death in the Afternoon, To Have and Have not.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৭) Who is the author of 'Death of a Salesman'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Arthur Miller is an American playwright. His famous works: Death of a Salesman, After the Fall, The Price, All My Sons, A View from the Bridge.
Source: An ABC of English Literature and Live MCQ lecture.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৮) 'Animal Farm' was written by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
George Orwell is an English novelist, essayist, journalist and critic. His real name is Eric Hugh Blair. He was a police officer in Burma.
His famous Novels are Animal Farm, Nineteen Eighty Four, Burmese Days, Coming up for Air.
Shooting an Elephant, A Hanging are Essay or Story by George Orwell.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ২৯) 'Caesar and Cleopatra' is a play by-
Daily Quiz.exp:
G. B. Shaw is the greatest modern dramatist and called the father of modern English drama. He is famous for his 'Drama of Ideas'.
His famous plays: Caesar and Cleopatra, The Philanderer, Arms and the Man, Man and Superman, Doctor's Dilemma, Major Barbara, Heartbreak House, The Devil's Discipline, The Apple Cart, St. Joan, Pygmalion, You Never Can Tell.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.

Daily Quiz.question: ৩০) Who is the author of 'A Farewell to Arms'?
Daily Quiz.exp:
Ernest Hemingway is an American novelist. He was awarded the Nobel prize in 1954 for literature.
His famous novels: A Farewell to Arms, The Old Man and The Sea, For Whom The Bell Tolls, The Sun Also Rises, Death in the Afternoon, To Have and Have not.
Source: Live MCQ Lecture and An ABC of English Literature.
